badge.reason.shots.failed.description: Status tag on a proposal's card and row label in the ledger on its page: taking the before and after screenshots failed. "Screenshots" are the pictures Homeroom takes of what a proposal changes, before and after.

badge.reason.shots.needed.description: Status tag on a proposal's card and row label in the ledger on its page: the proposal has no before and after screenshots for its current commit. "Screenshots" are the pictures Homeroom takes of what a proposal changes, before and after.

badge.reason.shots.retryingDetail.text: Homeroom restarted while taking these screenshots, so it starts them again on its own in a moment.
badge.reason.shots.retryingDetail.description: Tooltip of the status tag on a proposal's card, and text of the matching ledger row on its page: taking the screenshots was interrupted. "Homeroom" is the product's name. "Screenshots" are the pictures Homeroom takes of what a proposal changes, before and after.

badge.reason.shots.retryingFaultDetail.text: Something on Homeroom’s side stopped these screenshots, so it takes them again on its own.
badge.reason.shots.retryingFaultDetail.description: Tooltip of the status tag on a proposal's card, and text of the matching ledger row on its page: taking the screenshots failed for a reason on Homeroom's own side (not the proposal's), and Homeroom takes them again once by itself. "Homeroom" is the product's name. "Screenshots" are the pictures Homeroom takes of what a proposal changes, before and after.

badge.reason.shots.enforcedDetail.text: Voting and merging wait for before & after screenshots of the current proposal commit.
badge.reason.shots.enforcedDetail.description: Tooltip of the status tag on a proposal's card, and text of the matching ledger row on its page: the screenshots are missing, on a project where they are required before a vote. "Screenshots" are the pictures Homeroom takes of what a proposal changes, before and after.

badge.reason.shots.missingDetail.text: This proposal has no before & after screenshots for its current commit yet.
badge.reason.shots.missingDetail.description: Tooltip of the status tag on a proposal's card, and text of the matching ledger row on its page: the screenshots are missing, on a project where they are not required. "Screenshots" are the pictures Homeroom takes of what a proposal changes, before and after.

badge.tag.resolving.description: Status tag, beside a spinner, on a proposal's card while the platform resolves its merge conflict by itself. Keep the ellipsis.

badge.tag.resolvingTitle.text: Reconciling conflicts with main automatically, then retrying the merge.
badge.tag.resolvingTitle.description: Tooltip of the "Resolving conflicts automatically…" tag on a proposal's card. "main" is the name of the project's main line of code and stays as it is.

badge.tag.checksStarting.description: Status tag, beside a spinner, on a proposal's card when its automated checks are about to begin. Keep the ellipsis.

badge.pill.thresholdWas.description: Small note beside the vote tally on a change's page when the number of Yes votes needed has moved since voting began. {{now}} is the number needed now and {{was}} the number when voting opened.

badge.pill.live.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card (the rounded bar that shows the vote): the change is merged and running in the app. Keep the check mark.

badge.pill.liveTitle.text: This change is live in the app.
badge.pill.liveTitle.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card when it reads "✓ Live".

badge.pill.liveReload.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card when the change is live in the app but the page open in this tab still runs the version before it. A Reload button sits beside it. Keep the check mark and the middle dot.

badge.pill.liveReloadTitle.text: This change is live. This tab opened before it, so reload to get it here.
badge.pill.liveReloadTitle.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card when it reads "✓ Live · reload to get it".

badge.pill.goingLive.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card (the rounded bar that shows the vote): the change was approved and is on its way into the running app. Keep the ellipsis.

badge.pill.goingLiveRolling.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card while the release that carries it is rolling out to the platform's servers. It reads Live only once every server runs it. Keep the ellipsis.

badge.pill.goingLiveTitle.text: This change was approved. The app is still running the version before it.
badge.pill.goingLiveTitle.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card when it reads "Going live…" after the merge, while the app has not been updated yet.

badge.pill.mergingTitle.text: This change was approved and is going into the app now.
badge.pill.mergingTitle.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card when it reads "Going live…" while the change is being merged.

badge.pill.stuck.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card (the rounded bar that shows the vote): the change was approved, but the update that would put it in the running app is stuck.

badge.pill.stuckTitle.text: This change was approved, but the update that makes it live is stuck.
badge.pill.stuckTitle.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card when it reads "Stuck going live".

badge.pill.blocked.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card when the change was approved and merged, but the automatic release that would make it live failed one of its steps (for example a security check), so it cannot go live until that is fixed.

release.blocked.withReason.text: The release that makes this change live is blocked at “{{where}}”: {{reason}}
release.blocked.withReason.description: Tooltip of the "Release blocked" pill and the line under the steps on a merged change's page. {{where}} is the name of the release step that failed (for example "Audit all three lockfiles"); {{reason}} is that step's own error line, in English, often a package name and an advisory id.

release.blocked.where.text: The release that makes this change live is blocked at “{{where}}”.
release.blocked.where.description: Same as the previous line, when the failing step gave no reason. {{where}} is the name of the release step that failed.

badge.pill.failed.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card (the rounded bar that shows the vote): the change was approved, but the app failed to rebuild with it.

badge.pill.failedTitle.text: This change was approved, but the app failed to rebuild with it.
badge.pill.failedTitle.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card when it reads "Couldn’t go live".

badge.pill.contested.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card (the rounded bar that shows the vote): enough people voted No that the change can no longer pass on a timer and needs talking through. {{yes}} is the number of Yes votes that count and {{majority}} the number needed.

badge.pill.contestedTitle.text: Enough people have objected that the timer is off. This needs a straight majority of Yes votes, so talk it through.
badge.pill.contestedTitle.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card when it reads "Needs a conversation".

badge.pill.approvals_one.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card (the rounded bar that shows the vote): on a project where a change needs a fixed number of approvals. {{yes}} is how many it has and {{count}} how many it needs.

badge.pill.approvals_other.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card (the rounded bar that shows the vote): on a project where a change needs a fixed number of approvals. {{yes}} is how many it has and {{count}} how many it needs.

badge.pill.approvalsReachedTitle_one.text: Approval target reached ({{yes}} of {{count}}). Merges as soon as checks pass
badge.pill.approvalsReachedTitle_one.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card when the change has the approvals it needs. {{yes}} is how many it has and {{count}} how many it needs. "Merges" is a verb: the change merges.

badge.pill.approvalsReachedTitle_other.text: Approval target reached ({{yes}} of {{count}}). Merges as soon as checks pass
badge.pill.approvalsReachedTitle_other.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card when the change has the approvals it needs. {{yes}} is how many it has and {{count}} how many it needs. "Merges" is a verb: the change merges.

badge.pill.approvalsNeededTitle_one.text: Needs at least {{count}} approval to merge
badge.pill.approvalsNeededTitle_one.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card when the change does not have the approvals it needs yet. {{count}} is how many it needs.

badge.pill.approvalsNeededTitle_other.text: Needs at least {{count}} approvals to merge
badge.pill.approvalsNeededTitle_other.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card when the change does not have the approvals it needs yet. {{count}} is how many it needs.

badge.pill.goesLiveIn.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card (the rounded bar that shows the vote): the change has enough Yes votes and goes live when a waiting period ends. {{time}} is the time left, for example "~2d 5h".

badge.pill.goesLiveInTally.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card (the rounded bar that shows the vote): the change has support and no objection, and goes live when a waiting period ends unless more votes come in. {{time}} is the time left, for example "~5h". {{yes}} is the number of Yes votes that count and {{majority}} the number needed.

badge.pill.enoughYesTitle.text: Enough Yes votes ({{yes}} / {{majority}}). Goes live when the visibility window ends unless someone objects
badge.pill.enoughYesTitle.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card while it counts down with enough Yes votes. "the visibility window" is the waiting period that gives everyone time to see the change. {{yes}} is the number of Yes votes that count and {{majority}} the number needed.

badge.pill.hasSupportTitle.text: Has support ({{yes}} / {{majority}} yes) and nobody has objected. Goes live when the countdown ends unless more votes come in
badge.pill.hasSupportTitle.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card while it counts down with some Yes votes and no No. {{yes}} is the number of Yes votes that count and {{majority}} the number needed.

badge.pill.setAsideIn.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card (the rounded bar that shows the vote): more people voted No than Yes, and the change will be set aside (taken out of the vote) when a countdown ends. {{time}} is the time left, for example "~6h".

badge.pill.setAsideTitle.text: More No than Yes and not much support yet ({{yes}} / {{majority}}). It will be set aside when this runs out unless someone speaks up
badge.pill.setAsideTitle.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card while it counts down to being set aside. {{yes}} is the number of Yes votes that count and {{majority}} the number needed.

badge.pill.yourApproval.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card (the rounded bar that shows the vote): on a project that is only the viewer's own, the change waits for them to approve it.

badge.pill.yourApprovalTitle.text: Approve it, and it goes live
badge.pill.yourApprovalTitle.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card when it reads "Waiting for your approval".

badge.pill.noVote.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card (the rounded bar that shows the vote) for a project's first version, which goes live without a vote once it passes its checks.

badge.pill.noVoteTitle.text: A project’s first version goes live without a vote once testing passes.
badge.pill.noVoteTitle.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card when it reads "No vote needed".

badge.pill.needsYourYes.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card (the rounded bar that shows the vote): the change has enough Yes votes but still needs one from a member other than its author, and the viewer's would be it. {{yes}} is the number of Yes votes that count and {{majority}} the number needed.

badge.pill.vote.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card (the rounded bar that shows the vote): the viewer has not voted on this change yet. "Vote" asks them to. {{yes}} is the number of Yes votes that count and {{majority}} the number needed.

badge.pill.needsYourYesTitle.text: It has the Yes votes it needs ({{yes}} of {{majority}}), but none is from another member yet. Your Yes would be it.
badge.pill.needsYourYesTitle.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card when it reads "Needs your Yes". {{yes}} is the number of Yes votes that count and {{majority}} the number needed.

badge.pill.memberMissingTitle.text: It has the Yes votes it needs, but a Yes from another member is still missing.
badge.pill.memberMissingTitle.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card when the change has enough Yes votes but none from a member other than its author, and the viewer's own vote would not count.

badge.pill.notVotedTitle.text: You haven’t voted on this yet
badge.pill.notVotedTitle.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card when it reads "Vote".

badge.pill.needsMember.description: Label of the status pill on a change's card (the rounded bar that shows the vote): the change has enough Yes votes but still needs one from a member other than its author. {{yes}} is the number of Yes votes that count and {{majority}} the number needed.

badge.pill.neededAtMerge_one.text: needed {{needed}} of {{count}} active users at merge time
badge.pill.neededAtMerge_one.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card on a merged change: how many Yes votes it needed when it merged. {{needed}} is that number and {{count}} how many active members the project had then. Starts in lower case.

badge.pill.neededAtMerge_other.text: needed {{needed}} of {{count}} active users at merge time
badge.pill.neededAtMerge_other.description: Tooltip of the status pill on a change's card on a merged change: how many Yes votes it needed when it merged. {{needed}} is that number and {{count}} how many active members the project had then. Starts in lower case.

badge.votePill.advisoryTitle_one.text: {{count}} advisory Yes vote from non-approvers. They don't count toward merging
badge.votePill.advisoryTitle_one.description: Tooltip of the "+N advisory" chip beside the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion, on a project where only invited approvers' votes count. {{count}} is how many other people voted Yes.

badge.votePill.advisoryTitle_other.text: {{count}} advisory Yes votes from non-approvers. They don't count toward merging
badge.votePill.advisoryTitle_other.description: Tooltip of the "+N advisory" chip beside the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion, on a project where only invited approvers' votes count. {{count}} is how many other people voted Yes.

badge.votePill.advisory_one.description: Chip beside the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion: {{count}} people who are not approvers voted Yes; their votes are advisory. Keep the plus sign.

badge.votePill.advisory_other.description: Chip beside the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion: {{count}} people who are not approvers voted Yes; their votes are advisory. Keep the plus sign.

badge.votePill.explicit.description: Chip beside the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion when the proposal changes a protected setting and so cannot pass on a timer: another member must say Yes.

badge.votePill.approvalsReachedTitle_one.text: Approval target reached ({{yes}} of {{count}}). Merges as soon as checks pass
badge.votePill.approvalsReachedTitle_one.description: Tooltip of the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion when it has the approvals it needs. {{yes}} is how many it has and {{count}} how many it needs. "Merges" is a verb.

badge.votePill.approvalsReachedTitle_oth.text: Approval target reached ({{yes}} of {{count}}). Merges as soon as checks pass
badge.votePill.approvalsReachedTitle_oth.description: Tooltip of the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion when it has the approvals it needs. {{yes}} is how many it has and {{count}} how many it needs. "Merges" is a verb.

badge.votePill.approvalsNeededInvitedTit.text: Needs at least {{count}} approval from invited approvers to merge
badge.votePill.approvalsNeededInvitedTit.description: Tooltip of the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion on a project where only invited approvers' votes count. {{count}} is how many approvals it needs.

badge.votePill.approvalsNeededInvitedTit.text: Needs at least {{count}} approvals from invited approvers to merge
badge.votePill.approvalsNeededInvitedTit.description: Tooltip of the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion on a project where only invited approvers' votes count. {{count}} is how many approvals it needs.

badge.votePill.approvalsNeededAnyoneTitl.text: Needs at least {{count}} approval from any user to merge
badge.votePill.approvalsNeededAnyoneTitl.description: Tooltip of the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion on a project where anyone's vote counts. {{count}} is how many approvals it needs.

badge.votePill.approvalsNeededAnyoneTitl.text: Needs at least {{count}} approvals from any user to merge
badge.votePill.approvalsNeededAnyoneTitl.description: Tooltip of the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion on a project where anyone's vote counts. {{count}} is how many approvals it needs.

badge.votePill.approvals_one.description: Label of the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion on a project where a change needs a fixed number of approvals. {{yes}} is how many it has and {{count}} how many it needs.

badge.votePill.approvals_other.description: Label of the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion on a project where a change needs a fixed number of approvals. {{yes}} is how many it has and {{count}} how many it needs.

badge.votePill.enoughYesTitle.text: Enough Yes votes ({{yes}} / {{majority}}). Goes live when the visibility window ends unless someone objects
badge.votePill.enoughYesTitle.description: Tooltip of the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion while it counts down with enough Yes votes. "the visibility window" is the waiting period that gives everyone time to see the change. {{yes}} is the number of Yes votes that count and {{majority}} the number needed.

badge.votePill.hasSupportTitle.text: Has support ({{yes}} / {{majority}} yes) and nobody has objected. Goes live when the countdown ends unless more votes come in
badge.votePill.hasSupportTitle.description: Tooltip of the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion while it counts down with some Yes votes and no No. {{yes}} is the number of Yes votes that count and {{majority}} the number needed.

badge.votePill.goesLiveIn.description: Label of the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion: the proposal has enough Yes votes and goes live when a waiting period ends. {{time}} is the time left, for example "~2d 5h".

badge.votePill.goesLiveInTally.description: Label of the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion: the proposal has support and no objection, and goes live when a waiting period ends. {{time}} is the time left, for example "~5h". {{yes}} is the number of Yes votes that count and {{majority}} the number needed.

badge.votePill.setAsideTitle.text: More No than Yes and not much support yet ({{yes}} / {{majority}}). It will be set aside when this runs out unless someone speaks up
badge.votePill.setAsideTitle.description: Tooltip of the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion while it counts down to the proposal being set aside. {{yes}} is the number of Yes votes that count and {{majority}} the number needed.

badge.votePill.setAsideIn.description: Label of the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion: more people voted No than Yes, and the proposal will be set aside when a countdown ends. {{time}} is the time left, for example "~6h".

badge.votePill.neededAtMerge_one.text: needed {{needed}} of {{count}} active users at merge time
badge.votePill.neededAtMerge_one.description: Tooltip of the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion on a merged proposal. {{needed}} is how many Yes votes it needed when it merged and {{count}} how many active members the project had then. Starts in lower case.

badge.votePill.neededAtMerge_other.text: needed {{needed}} of {{count}} active users at merge time
badge.votePill.neededAtMerge_other.description: Tooltip of the small vote pill beside a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion on a merged proposal. {{needed}} is how many Yes votes it needed when it merged and {{count}} how many active members the project had then. Starts in lower case.

badge.votePill.tallyWords_one.description: The vote count on a proposal's card inside a chat, said in words: how many Yes votes it has and how many it needs to go live. Here it needs one vote.

badge.votePill.tallyWords_other.description: The vote count on a proposal's card inside a chat, said in words: how many Yes votes it has and how many it needs to go live. {{yes}} is how many it has, {{count}} is how many it needs.

badge.votePill.tallyReached_one.description: The vote count on a proposal's card inside a chat, said in words, once it has as many Yes votes as it needs or more: how many Yes votes it has. Here it has one. What it needed is not repeated, so it never reads as more than was possible.

badge.votePill.tallyReached_other.description: The vote count on a proposal's card inside a chat, said in words, once it has as many Yes votes as it needs or more: how many Yes votes it has. What it needed is not repeated, so it never reads as more than was possible.

badge.merge.merging.description: Badge, beside a spinner, next to a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion while it is being merged. Keep the ellipsis.

badge.merge.merged.description: Badge next to a proposal mentioned in a project's discussion once it is merged. Keep the check mark.

badge.agent.external.description: Phrase that names the tool a change was made with when it was neither Claude Code nor Codex: some other AI coding agent outside Homeroom. Lower case, with its article.

badge.agent.builtWith.description: Small upper-cased badge on a proposal that was written by the proposer's own AI coding agent. {{agent}} is that product's name, Claude Code or Codex.

badge.agent.builtWithOther.description: Small upper-cased badge on a proposal that was written by the proposer's own AI coding agent, when it is not one Homeroom knows by name.

badge.agent.title.text: The code was written by the proposer’s own coding agent ({{agent}}) on their subscription, in their GitHub fork. Homeroom opened the pull request; the group still votes on it.
badge.agent.title.description: Tooltip of the "Built with …" badge on a proposal. {{agent}} is the product's name, Claude Code or Codex. "Homeroom" is the product's name; a fork is the proposer's own copy of the code on GitHub.

badge.agent.titleOther.text: The code was written by the proposer’s own coding agent (an external coding agent) on their subscription, in their GitHub fork. Homeroom opened the pull request; the group still votes on it.
badge.agent.titleOther.description: Tooltip of the "Built with a coding agent" badge on a proposal, when the agent is not one Homeroom knows by name. "Homeroom" is the product's name; a fork is the proposer's own copy of the code on GitHub.

badge.console.label.description: Amber warning badge on a proposal whose staging preview logged errors in the browser console. Keep the warning sign.

badge.console.labelCount_one.description: Amber warning badge on a proposal whose staging preview logged errors in the browser console. {{count}} is how many. Keep the warning sign.

badge.console.labelCount_other.description: Amber warning badge on a proposal whose staging preview logged errors in the browser console. {{count}} is how many. Keep the warning sign.

badge.console.title.text: The staging preview logged console errors. This change may break the app.
badge.console.title.description: Tooltip of the "⚠ Console errors" badge on a proposal when the number of errors is not known.

badge.console.titleCount_one.text: The staging preview logged {{count}} console error. This change may break the app. Open the discussion to see them.
badge.console.titleCount_one.description: Tooltip of the "⚠ Console errors" badge on a proposal. {{count}} is how many errors the preview logged. "Open" is an instruction.

badge.console.titleCount_other.text: The staging preview logged {{count}} console errors. This change may break the app. Open the discussion to see them.
badge.console.titleCount_other.description: Tooltip of the "⚠ Console errors" badge on a proposal. {{count}} is how many errors the preview logged. "Open" is an instruction.

card.provenance.builtWithExternal.text: built with an external coding agent
card.provenance.builtWithExternal.description: Fact on a proposal card's line of details: the change was made with an AI coding agent that is neither Claude Code nor Codex. Lower case: it sits among other facts separated by dots.

page.hero.provenance.builtWithExternal.text: built with an external coding agent
page.hero.provenance.builtWithExternal.description: One fact at the end of the by-line under a change's title, after a middle dot, so it starts in lower case: the change was made with an AI coding agent that is neither Claude Code nor Codex.

chips.checks.starting.description: Small status chip on a proposal's card while its staging preview is being prepared, before the automated checks begin. A spinner is drawn before it.

chips.checks.startingTitle.text: The staging preview is being prepared and automated tests are about to run. Merge is blocked until they pass.
chips.checks.startingTitle.description: Tooltip of the "Checks starting…" chip on a proposal's card. "Merge" is the proposal going live.

chips.checks.passing.description: Small status chip on a proposal's card: every automated check passed. Keep the leading check mark.

chips.checks.passingTitle.text: All automated tests passed on the staging build
chips.checks.passingTitle.description: Tooltip of the "Checks passing" chip on a proposal's card.

chips.checks.failing.description: Small status chip on a proposal's card: its automated checks failed and the number that failed is not known. Keep the leading warning sign.

chips.checks.failingCount_one.description: Small status chip on a proposal's card: its automated checks failed. {{count}} is how many checks failed, shown as a bare number after the dot. Keep the leading warning sign.

chips.checks.failingCount_other.description: Small status chip on a proposal's card: its automated checks failed. {{count}} is how many checks failed, shown as a bare number after the dot. Keep the leading warning sign.

chips.checks.failingTitle.text: Automated tests failed on the staging build. Merge is blocked until checks pass.
chips.checks.failingTitle.description: Tooltip of the "Checks failing" chip on a proposal's card when the number of failed tests is not known. "Merge" is the proposal going live.

chips.checks.failingCountTitle_one.text: {{count}} automated test failed on the staging build. Merge is blocked until checks pass. Open the discussion to see them.
chips.checks.failingCountTitle_one.description: Tooltip of the "Checks failing" chip on a proposal's card. {{count}} is how many automated tests failed. "Merge" is the proposal going live.

chips.checks.failingCountTitle_other.text: {{count}} automated tests failed on the staging build. Merge is blocked until checks pass. Open the discussion to see them.
chips.checks.failingCountTitle_other.description: Tooltip of the "Checks failing" chip on a proposal's card. {{count}} is how many automated tests failed. "Merge" is the proposal going live.

chips.checks.error.description: Small status chip on a proposal's card: the automated checks could not run at all, because the build or the test run itself broke. Keep the leading warning sign.

chips.checks.errorTitle.text: The staging build or the test run itself broke, so the platform can't confirm the app works. Merge is blocked until checks pass.
chips.checks.errorTitle.description: Tooltip of the "Checks couldn't run" chip on a proposal's card. "Merge" is the proposal going live.

chips.checks.skipped.description: Small status chip on a proposal's card: the automated checks were skipped because there was nothing to test. It does not block the proposal.

chips.checks.skippedTitle.text: Checks were skipped: there was nothing to test. It can still go live.
chips.checks.skippedTitle.description: Tooltip of the "Checks skipped" chip on a proposal's card when no reason was recorded. "It" is the proposal.

chips.checks.skippedBecauseTitle.text: Checks were skipped: {{reason}}. It can still go live.
chips.checks.skippedBecauseTitle.description: Tooltip of the "Checks skipped" chip on a proposal's card. {{reason}} is the server's own explanation of why they were skipped, written without a final period. "It" is the proposal.

chips.checks.running.description: Small status chip on a proposal's card while its automated checks are running and no progress count is known. A spinner is drawn before it.

chips.checks.runningRan.description: Small status chip on a proposal's card while its automated checks are running and the total is not known yet. {{ran}} is how many checks have finished so far.

chips.checks.runningTitle.text: Automated tests are still running on the staging build. Merge is blocked until they pass.
chips.checks.runningTitle.description: Tooltip of the "Checks running…" chip on a proposal's card. "Merge" is the proposal going live.

shots.state.notStarted.label.description: Heading of the screenshots card on a proposal when the before/after screenshots were asked for a while ago and nothing has started taking them. "Before & after" names the pair of screenshots.

shots.state.notStarted.detail.text: Nothing has picked this preview up yet.
shots.state.notStarted.detail.description: Sentence under "Before & after not started" on a proposal's screenshots card, when the server recorded no reason. "This preview" is the proposal's staging build that the screenshots are taken of.

shots.state.queued.label.description: Heading of the screenshots card on a proposal while its before/after screenshots wait to start.

shots.state.queued.detail.text: Getting ready to take the screenshots.
shots.state.queued.detail.description: Sentence under "Before & after queued" on a proposal's screenshots card. "Screenshots" are the pictures Homeroom takes of a change, before and after.

shots.state.building.label.description: Heading of the screenshots card on a proposal while Homeroom starts the two copies of the app (before the change and after it) that the screenshots are taken of.

shots.state.building.detail.text: Homeroom is starting private copies of the app from before and after this change.
shots.state.building.detail.description: Sentence under "Building before and after" on a proposal's screenshots card. Homeroom is the product's name.

shots.state.taking.label.description: Heading of the screenshots card on a proposal while the before/after screenshots are being taken.

shots.state.taking.detail.text: The screenshot agent is following each declared change on the before and after builds.
shots.state.taking.detail.description: Sentence under "Taking the screenshots" on a proposal's screenshots card. The "screenshot agent" is the automated program that takes the screenshots; a "declared change" is one thing the author said the proposal changes on screen.

shots.state.saving.label.description: Heading of the screenshots card on a proposal while the finished before/after screenshots are being saved.

shots.state.saving.detail.text: The screenshots are being saved to the proposal.
shots.state.saving.detail.description: Sentence under "Saving the screenshots" on a proposal's screenshots card.

shots.state.changeFailed.label.description: Heading of the screenshots card on a proposal when the screenshot agent tried the change on the new build and the app broke.

shots.state.changeFailed.detail.text: The screenshot agent tried this change on the after build, and the app broke.
shots.state.changeFailed.detail.description: Sentence under "Something didn’t work" on a proposal's screenshots card, when the server gave no reason. The "after build" is the app with the proposal applied.

shots.state.stopped.label.description: Heading of the screenshots card on a proposal after someone stopped the before/after screenshots part way.

shots.state.stopped.detail.text: Stopped before it finished. No screenshots were taken for this commit.
shots.state.stopped.detail.description: Sentence under "Screenshots stopped" on a proposal's screenshots card, when the server gave no reason. "It" is the run that takes the screenshots; a commit is one saved revision of the proposal's code.

shots.state.retrying.label.description: Heading of the screenshots card on a proposal when taking the screenshots was interrupted and Homeroom is about to start it again by itself.

shots.state.retrying.detail.text: Homeroom restarted while taking these screenshots, so it starts them again on its own in a moment.
shots.state.retrying.detail.description: Sentence under "Trying the screenshots again" on a proposal's screenshots card. Homeroom is the product's name.

shots.state.retryingFault.detail.text: Something on Homeroom’s side stopped these screenshots, so it takes them again on its own.
shots.state.retryingFault.detail.description: Sentence under "Trying the screenshots again" on a proposal's screenshots card, when taking the screenshots failed for a reason on Homeroom's own side (not the proposal's) and Homeroom takes them again once by itself. Homeroom is the product's name.

shots.state.couldNot.label.description: Heading of the screenshots card on a proposal when the before/after screenshots failed for a reason other than the change itself.

shots.state.couldNot.detail.text: The screenshot agent could not take the before & after screenshots.
shots.state.couldNot.detail.description: Sentence under "Couldn’t take the screenshots" on a proposal's screenshots card, when the server gave no reason.

shots.state.stale.label.description: Heading of the screenshots card on a proposal when its screenshots were taken of an older revision.

shots.state.stale.detail.text: A newer revision of this proposal replaced these screenshots.
shots.state.stale.detail.description: Sentence under "Screenshots are out of date" on a proposal's screenshots card, when the server gave no reason.

shots.state.cancelled.label.description: Heading of the screenshots card on a proposal when the run taking its screenshots was cancelled because a newer run began.

shots.state.cancelled.detail.text: A newer run replaced this one before it finished.
shots.state.cancelled.detail.description: Sentence under "Screenshots cancelled" on a proposal's screenshots card, when the server gave no reason. A "run" is one attempt at taking the screenshots.

shots.state.notRequired.label.description: Heading of the screenshots card on a proposal that changes nothing people can see, so no before/after screenshots are taken.

shots.state.notRequired.detail.text: This proposal has no visual changes.
shots.state.notRequired.detail.description: Sentence under "No before & after needed" on a proposal's screenshots card, and the whole line about screenshots on the change's page in that case.

shots.state.waived.label.description: Heading of the screenshots card on a proposal when an administrator allowed review to go on without before/after screenshots.

shots.state.waived.detail.text: An app administrator let review continue without before & after screenshots.
shots.state.waived.detail.description: Sentence under "Screenshots waived" on a proposal's screenshots card, and the line about screenshots on the change's page, when the administrator gave no reason.

shots.state.pending.label.description: Heading and badge of the screenshots card on a proposal when the screenshots are in a state this version does not know: they are not ready yet.

shots.state.pending.detail.text: The before & after screenshots are not ready yet.
shots.state.pending.detail.description: Sentence under "Screenshots pending" on a proposal's screenshots card.

shots.sentence.readyLabel.description: Short label on a change's page, under "What changes for you", once the before/after screenshots of the proposal are taken.

shots.sentence.notStarted.text: Before & after not started. Nothing has picked this preview up yet. None have been taken for this commit yet.
shots.sentence.notStarted.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", when the before/after screenshots never started and no reason was recorded. "This preview" is the proposal's staging build; "None" refers to screenshots; a commit is one saved revision of the code.

shots.sentence.notStartedBecause.text: Before & after not started. {{reason}}. None have been taken for this commit yet.
shots.sentence.notStartedBecause.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", when the before/after screenshots never started. {{reason}} is the server's own sentence saying why, without its final period. "None" refers to screenshots.

shots.sentence.queued.text: Before & after: getting ready to take the screenshots. Homeroom shows each declared change before and after, on this exact proposal build.
shots.sentence.queued.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", while the before/after screenshots wait to start. Homeroom is the product's name; a "declared change" is one thing the author said the proposal changes on screen.

shots.sentence.building.text: Before & after: homeroom is starting private copies of the app from before and after this change. Homeroom shows each declared change before and after, on this exact proposal build.
shots.sentence.building.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", while Homeroom starts the two copies of the app that the screenshots are taken of. Homeroom is the product's name (the English writes it small after the colon; a translation may capitalize it).

shots.sentence.taking.text: Before & after: the screenshot agent is following each declared change on the before and after builds. Homeroom shows each declared change before and after, on this exact proposal build.
shots.sentence.taking.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", while the before/after screenshots are being taken. The "screenshot agent" is the automated program that takes them; Homeroom is the product's name.

shots.sentence.saving.text: Before & after: the screenshots are being saved to the proposal. Homeroom shows each declared change before and after, on this exact proposal build.
shots.sentence.saving.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", while the finished before/after screenshots are being saved. Homeroom is the product's name.

shots.sentence.changeFailed.text: Something didn’t work. The screenshot agent tried this change on the after build, and the app broke.
shots.sentence.changeFailed.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", when the screenshot agent tried the change on the new build and the app broke, and the server gave no reason.

shots.sentence.changeFailedBecause.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", when the screenshot agent tried the change and the app broke. {{reason}} is the server's own sentence saying what broke, without its final period.

shots.sentence.stopped.text: Screenshots stopped. Stopped before it finished. No screenshots were taken for this commit.
shots.sentence.stopped.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", after someone stopped the before/after screenshots part way, when the server gave no reason. "It" is the run taking the screenshots.

shots.sentence.stoppedBecause.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", after the before/after screenshots were stopped. {{reason}} is the server's own sentence about it, without its final period.

shots.sentence.retrying.text: Trying the screenshots again. Homeroom restarted while taking these screenshots, so it starts them again on its own in a moment.
shots.sentence.retrying.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", when taking the screenshots was interrupted and starts again by itself. Homeroom is the product's name.

shots.sentence.retryingFault.text: Trying the screenshots again. Something on Homeroom’s side stopped these screenshots, so it takes them again on its own.
shots.sentence.retryingFault.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", when taking the screenshots failed for a reason on Homeroom's own side (not the proposal's) and Homeroom takes them again once by itself. Homeroom is the product's name.

shots.sentence.couldNot.text: Couldn’t take the screenshots. The screenshot agent could not take the before & after screenshots.
shots.sentence.couldNot.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", when the before/after screenshots failed and the server gave no reason.

shots.sentence.couldNotBecause.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", when the before/after screenshots failed. {{reason}} is the server's own sentence saying why, without its final period.

shots.sentence.stale.text: Screenshots are out of date. A newer revision of this proposal replaced these screenshots.
shots.sentence.stale.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", when the screenshots belong to an older revision and the server gave no reason.

shots.sentence.staleBecause.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", when the screenshots belong to an older revision. {{reason}} is the server's own sentence about it, without its final period.

shots.sentence.cancelled.text: Screenshots cancelled. A newer run replaced this one before it finished.
shots.sentence.cancelled.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", when the run taking the screenshots was cancelled and the server gave no reason.

shots.sentence.cancelledBecause.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", when the run taking the screenshots was cancelled. {{reason}} is the server's own sentence about it, without its final period.

shots.sentence.pending.text: Screenshots pending. The before & after screenshots are not ready yet.
shots.sentence.pending.description: Line on a change's page, under "What changes for you", when the before/after screenshots are not ready and nothing more specific is known.

shots.size.desktop.description: Name of a screen size in the before/after viewer on a proposal: screenshots taken at a desktop computer's window size. Shown on the size switch and in the line under the screenshot.

shots.size.phone.description: Name of a screen size in the before/after viewer on a proposal: screenshots taken at a phone's screen size. Shown on the size switch and in the line under the screenshot.

shots.size.screen.description: Name shown in the before/after viewer on a proposal for a screenshot whose screen size was not recorded. A noun: a device's screen.

shots.sizeWord.desktop.description: A screen size named inside a line of text about a proposal's before/after screenshots, for example "Before clip · desktop" or "desktop, phone · member". Lower case in English because it sits mid-line.

shots.sizeWord.phone.description: A screen size named inside a line of text about a proposal's before/after screenshots, for example "Before clip · phone" or "desktop, phone · member". Lower case in English because it sits mid-line.

shots.viewer.previousScreen.description: Tooltip of the left arrow in the before/after viewer on a proposal: shows the previous screenshot of the same screen size.

shots.viewer.nextScreen.description: Tooltip of the right arrow in the before/after viewer on a proposal: shows the next screenshot of the same screen size.

shots.viewer.screenCount.description: Position counter between the arrows of the before/after viewer on a proposal. {{index}} is the number of the screenshot shown and {{total}} how many there are at this screen size.

shots.viewer.sideBySide.description: Button in the before/after viewer on a proposal, and its tooltip: shows the before and after screenshots next to each other.

shots.viewer.closeUp.description: Button in the before/after viewer, and its tooltip: zooms in on the part of the screen that changes. A noun.

shots.viewer.wholeScreen.description: Button in the before/after viewer, and its tooltip: shows the entire screenshot instead of the close-up.

shots.viewer.before.description: Button in the before/after viewer on a proposal: shows the screenshot taken before the change.

shots.viewer.after.description: Button in the before/after viewer on a proposal: shows the screenshot taken after the change.

shots.viewer.clickBefore.description: Tooltip over the screenshot in the before/after viewer while the "after" side is shown: clicking switches to the screenshot from before the change.

shots.viewer.clickAfter.description: Tooltip over the screenshot in the before/after viewer while the "before" side is shown: clicking switches to the screenshot from after the change.

shots.viewer.chipAfter.description: Small tag in the corner of a screenshot in the before/after viewer, marking it as the screen after the change.

shots.viewer.chipBefore.description: Small tag in the corner of a screenshot in the before/after viewer, marking it as the screen before the change.

shots.viewer.chipBeforeAbsent.description: Small tag in the corner of a screenshot in the before/after viewer, marking it as the screen before the change when the changed feature did not exist yet.

shots.viewer.showBefore.text: Show the screen before the change
shots.viewer.showBefore.description: Accessible name of the hidden option in the before/after viewer that shows the screenshot from before the change.

shots.viewer.showAfter.text: Show the screen after the change
shots.viewer.showAfter.description: Accessible name of the hidden option in the before/after viewer that shows the screenshot from after the change.

shots.viewer.showBoth.text: Show before and after side by side
shots.viewer.showBoth.description: Accessible name of the hidden option in the before/after viewer that shows both screenshots next to each other.

shots.viewer.showAuto.text: Show side by side when there is room, otherwise after
shots.viewer.showAuto.description: Accessible name of the hidden starting option in the before/after viewer: both screenshots next to each other on a wide window, only the one after the change on a narrow one.

shots.viewer.showCloseUp.text: Show a close-up of what changes
shots.viewer.showCloseUp.description: Accessible name of the hidden option in the before/after viewer that zooms in on the changed part of the screen.

shots.viewer.showWhole.description: Accessible name of the hidden option in the before/after viewer that shows the entire screenshot.

shots.viewer.showDark.description: Hover text and accessible name of the small round button at the right end of the before/after viewer's toolbar that switches the screenshots to their dark-mode versions, when the run took them in both modes. It shows a moon.

shots.viewer.showLight.description: Hover text and accessible name of the small round button at the right end of the before/after viewer's toolbar that switches the screenshots to their light-mode versions, when the run took them in both modes. It shows a sun.

shots.viewer.expand.description: Hover text and accessible name of the small round button at the end of the before/after viewer's toolbar that opens the screenshots at nearly the size of the window, over the page.

shots.viewer.collapse.description: Accessible name of the same small round button once the before/after screenshots are open at nearly the size of the window: it puts them back in the page.

shots.viewer.pickDesktop.description: Accessible name of the hidden option in the before/after viewer that picks one screenshot taken at desktop size. {{index}} is its number and {{total}} how many screenshots the viewer holds.

shots.viewer.pickPhone.description: Accessible name of the hidden option in the before/after viewer that picks one screenshot taken at phone size. {{index}} is its number and {{total}} how many screenshots the viewer holds.

shots.viewer.pickOther.description: Accessible name of the hidden option in the before/after viewer that picks one screenshot. {{index}} is its number, {{total}} how many screenshots the viewer holds, and {{size}} the screen size as the server named it.

shots.card.unknownCommit.description: Stands in for a code revision's short id in the screenshots card's "before … → after …" line when the id is missing.

shots.card.readyBadge.description: Badge on a proposal's screenshots card once its before/after screenshots are taken.

shots.card.beforeCommit.description: Small print on a proposal's screenshots card naming the code revision the "before" screenshots were taken of. {{commit}} is that revision's short id; keep it inside the tags, which set it in code type.

shots.card.afterCommit.description: Small print on a proposal's screenshots card naming the code revision the "after" screenshots were taken of. {{commit}} is that revision's short id; keep it inside the tags, which set it in code type.

shots.card.takeAgain.description: Button on a proposal's screenshots card: starts taking the before/after screenshots over again.

shots.card.stop.description: Button on a proposal's screenshots card while the before/after screenshots are being taken: stops taking them.

shots.card.overriddenAt.description: Small print on a proposal's screenshots card when an administrator waived the screenshots. {{when}} is the date and time they did it.

shots.card.missingDetails.text: These before & after screenshots are missing their details, so none can be shown.
shots.card.missingDetails.description: Error shown in place of a proposal's before/after viewer when the screenshots were taken but the record describing them is missing.

shots.card.intro.text: Taken on the exact before and after builds of this proposal. Look at the screenshots to decide whether they show the change.
shots.card.intro.description: Opening line of a proposal's screenshots card, above the before/after viewer, when it holds screenshots only.

shots.card.introClips.text: Taken on the exact before and after builds of this proposal. Look at the screenshots and clips to decide whether they show the change.
shots.card.introClips.description: Opening line of a proposal's screenshots card, above the before/after viewer, when it holds short video clips as well as screenshots.

shots.card.introNewApp.text: New app: nothing before. This proposal builds the app’s first real screens, so these are its after screenshots only. Look at them to decide whether they show the change.
shots.card.introNewApp.description: Opening line of a proposal's screenshots card, above the viewer, when the proposal builds a new app's first real screens: before it there was only the starter template's placeholder screen, so only screenshots after the change were taken.

shots.card.introNewAppClips.text: New app: nothing before. This proposal builds the app’s first real screens, so these are its after screenshots and clips only. Look at them to decide whether they show the change.
shots.card.introNewAppClips.description: Opening line of a proposal's screenshots card, above the viewer, when the proposal builds a new app's first real screens and the card holds short video clips as well as screenshots: before it there was only the starter template's placeholder screen, so only the after side was recorded.

shots.card.label.description: Accessible name of the section of a proposal that holds its before/after screenshots.

shots.card.details.description: Disclosure label at the bottom of a proposal's screenshots card: opens technical details of the screenshots (which revisions they were taken of).

shots.card.planHash.description: Small print in the screenshots card's details naming the screenshots by their short identifier. {{hash}} is that identifier; keep it inside the tags, which set it in code type.

shots.card.unknownPlan.description: Stands in for the screenshots' short identifier in the screenshots card's details when it is missing.

shots.card.takenByAgent.description: Small print in the screenshots card's details: the screenshots were taken by Homeroom's automated screenshot agent. Lower case in English because it continues a line of small facts.

shots.persona.member.description: Who the screenshot agent was signed in as when it took a screenshot: an ordinary member of the community. Shown after the screen sizes on a declared change's line, as in "desktop · member".

shots.persona.readOnlyAdmin.description: Who the screenshot agent was signed in as when it took a screenshot: an administrator who can look but not change anything. Shown after the screen sizes on a declared change's line.

shots.persona.fullAdmin.description: Who the screenshot agent was signed in as when it took a screenshot: an administrator with every permission. Shown after the screen sizes on a declared change's line.

shots.persona.guest.description: Who the screenshot agent was when it took a screenshot: a visitor who is not signed in. Shown after the screen sizes on a declared change's line.

shots.seenAs.member.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change and in its Screenshot details, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"): the screen was viewed as an ordinary member of the community. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.readOnlyAdmin.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change and in its Screenshot details, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"): the screen was viewed as an administrator who can look but not change anything. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.fullAdmin.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change and in its Screenshot details, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"): the screen was viewed as an administrator with every permission. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.guest.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change and in its Screenshot details, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"): the screen was viewed as a visitor who is not signed in. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.memberReadOnlyAdmin.text: seen as a member and a read-only admin
shots.seenAs.memberReadOnlyAdmin.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as two kinds of people, named in this order: an ordinary member of the community; an administrator who can look but not change anything. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.memberFullAdmin.text: seen as a member and a full admin
shots.seenAs.memberFullAdmin.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as two kinds of people, named in this order: an ordinary member of the community; an administrator with every permission. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.memberGuest.text: seen as a member and a signed-out visitor
shots.seenAs.memberGuest.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as two kinds of people, named in this order: an ordinary member of the community; a visitor who is not signed in. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.readOnlyAdminMember.text: seen as a read-only admin and a member
shots.seenAs.readOnlyAdminMember.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as two kinds of people, named in this order: an administrator who can look but not change anything; an ordinary member of the community. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.readOnlyAdminFullAdmin.text: seen as a read-only admin and a full admin
shots.seenAs.readOnlyAdminFullAdmin.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as two kinds of people, named in this order: an administrator who can look but not change anything; an administrator with every permission. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.readOnlyAdminGuest.text: seen as a read-only admin and a signed-out visitor
shots.seenAs.readOnlyAdminGuest.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as two kinds of people, named in this order: an administrator who can look but not change anything; a visitor who is not signed in. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.fullAdminMember.text: seen as a full admin and a member
shots.seenAs.fullAdminMember.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as two kinds of people, named in this order: an administrator with every permission; an ordinary member of the community. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.fullAdminReadOnlyAdmin.text: seen as a full admin and a read-only admin
shots.seenAs.fullAdminReadOnlyAdmin.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as two kinds of people, named in this order: an administrator with every permission; an administrator who can look but not change anything. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.fullAdminGuest.text: seen as a full admin and a signed-out visitor
shots.seenAs.fullAdminGuest.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as two kinds of people, named in this order: an administrator with every permission; a visitor who is not signed in. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.guestMember.text: seen as a signed-out visitor and a member
shots.seenAs.guestMember.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as two kinds of people, named in this order: a visitor who is not signed in; an ordinary member of the community. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.guestReadOnlyAdmin.text: seen as a signed-out visitor and a read-only admin
shots.seenAs.guestReadOnlyAdmin.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as two kinds of people, named in this order: a visitor who is not signed in; an administrator who can look but not change anything. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.guestFullAdmin.text: seen as a signed-out visitor and a full admin
shots.seenAs.guestFullAdmin.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as two kinds of people, named in this order: a visitor who is not signed in; an administrator with every permission. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.memberReadOnlyAdminFullAdmi.text: seen as a member and a read-only admin and a full admin
shots.seenAs.memberReadOnlyAdminFullAdmi.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as three kinds of people, named in this order: an ordinary member of the community; an administrator who can look but not change anything; an administrator with every permission. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.memberReadOnlyAdminGuest.text: seen as a member and a read-only admin and a signed-out visitor
shots.seenAs.memberReadOnlyAdminGuest.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as three kinds of people, named in this order: an ordinary member of the community; an administrator who can look but not change anything; a visitor who is not signed in. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.memberFullAdminReadOnlyAdmi.text: seen as a member and a full admin and a read-only admin
shots.seenAs.memberFullAdminReadOnlyAdmi.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as three kinds of people, named in this order: an ordinary member of the community; an administrator with every permission; an administrator who can look but not change anything. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.memberFullAdminGuest.text: seen as a member and a full admin and a signed-out visitor
shots.seenAs.memberFullAdminGuest.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as three kinds of people, named in this order: an ordinary member of the community; an administrator with every permission; a visitor who is not signed in. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.memberGuestReadOnlyAdmin.text: seen as a member and a signed-out visitor and a read-only admin
shots.seenAs.memberGuestReadOnlyAdmin.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as three kinds of people, named in this order: an ordinary member of the community; a visitor who is not signed in; an administrator who can look but not change anything. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.memberGuestFullAdmin.text: seen as a member and a signed-out visitor and a full admin
shots.seenAs.memberGuestFullAdmin.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as three kinds of people, named in this order: an ordinary member of the community; a visitor who is not signed in; an administrator with every permission. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.readOnlyAdminMemberFullAdmi.text: seen as a read-only admin and a member and a full admin
shots.seenAs.readOnlyAdminMemberFullAdmi.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as three kinds of people, named in this order: an administrator who can look but not change anything; an ordinary member of the community; an administrator with every permission. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.

shots.seenAs.readOnlyAdminMemberGuest.text: seen as a read-only admin and a member and a signed-out visitor
shots.seenAs.readOnlyAdminMemberGuest.description: One fact in the line under a before/after screenshot of a change, after the screen size and a middle dot ("Desktop · seen as …"), when the changes on that screen were viewed as three kinds of people, named in this order: an administrator who can look but not change anything; an ordinary member of the community; a visitor who is not signed in. Lower case in English because it follows the dot.
