request.status.lead.workingSomeoneOthers.text: Someone and {{count}} others are working on this.
request.status.lead.workingSomeoneOthers.description: The one sentence on the status card of a request's page that says where the request stands. Somebody is working on the request now, or said they would. Nobody is named; {{count}} is how many people there are besides the first.

request.status.note.closedByNumber.description: Second sentence on the status card of a request's page, after the one that says where the request stands. The change with pull request number {{number}} went live and closed the request. Keep the # before the number.

request.status.note.closedByChange.description: Second sentence on the status card of a request's page, after the one that says where the request stands. A change that has no pull request number went live and closed the request. "Change" is a noun standing where the change's number would.

request.status.note.review.text: A change for it is waiting for approval.
request.status.note.review.description: Second sentence on the status card of a request's page, after the one that says where the request stands. "It" is the request; a change (a proposal that fulfils it) is up for the group's vote.

request.status.note.underway.text: A change for it is underway.
request.status.note.underway.description: Second sentence on the status card of a request's page, after the one that says where the request stands. "It" is the request; a change that fulfils it is being built.

request.status.note.outdated.text: Homeroom bot can do more since it said this, so this may be out of date.
request.status.note.outdated.description: Small print on the status card of a request's page, under the sentence that says Homeroom bot is waiting for the viewer: the reason it gave for handing the request back may no longer be true, because a later release lifted a limit it had. "This" is the reason.

request.status.note.outdatedPostedPlan.text: Homeroom bot can read posted plans now, so this may be out of date.
request.status.note.outdatedPostedPlan.description: Small print on the status card of a request's page, under the sentence that says Homeroom bot is waiting for the viewer: it handed the request back because it could not read a plan a person posted, and it can read those since 6 November 2026, so its reason may no longer be true. "This" is the reason.

request.status.fine.lapses.text: If nothing moves by {{date}}, it opens up for someone else.
request.status.fine.lapses.description: Small print on the status card of a request's page while somebody's claim on the request stands. {{date}} is a short date such as "Oct 12": with no activity by then the claim clears itself and anyone can take the request.

request.status.action.seeChange.description: Link on the status card of a request's page: opens the page of the change that addresses the request. "Change" is a noun.

request.status.action.continueWork.description: Main button on the status card of a request's page, for a person who already has an agent session on the request: opens that session.

request.status.action.continueWorkTitle.text: Open your agent session on this request
request.status.action.continueWorkTitle.description: Tooltip on the Continue your work button of a request's status card. An agent session is a working conversation with an AI coding agent; "Open" is a verb.

request.status.action.goAhead.description: Main button on the status card of a request's page, while Homeroom bot (the platform's assistant) waits for a person to decide: opens a reply to the bot's note with the words "Go ahead" ready to send. Keep it the same as the Go ahead button in the note's own answers.

request.status.action.goAheadTitle.text: Reply Go ahead to Homeroom bot's note
request.status.action.goAheadTitle.description: Tooltip on the Go ahead button of a request's status card: opens a reply to Homeroom bot's note with "Go ahead" already written. "Homeroom bot" is the name of the platform's assistant.

request.status.action.readAgain.text: Ask Homeroom bot to read this again
request.status.action.readAgain.description: Main button on the status card of a request's page, when the reason Homeroom bot gave for handing the request back is out of date: it reads the request again and replies in its thread. "This" is the request.

request.status.action.readAgainTitle.text: Homeroom bot reads this request again and replies here
request.status.action.readAgainTitle.description: Tooltip on the Ask Homeroom bot to read this again button of a request's status card. "Homeroom bot" is the name of the platform's assistant; it reads the request again and says what it found in its discussion.

request.status.closed.plain.description: The sentence on the status card of a closed request's page, shown in place of its progress, when neither who closed it nor when is known.

request.status.closed.plainWhen.description: The sentence on the status card of a closed request's page, shown in place of its progress, when it is not known who closed it. {{when}} is how long ago or a date, for example "3h ago" or "Oct 5".

request.status.closed.byAdmin.text: This request was closed by an admin.
request.status.closed.byAdmin.description: The sentence on the status card of a closed request's page, shown in place of its progress, when an administrator closed it.

request.status.closed.byAdminWhen.text: This request was closed by an admin, {{when}}.
request.status.closed.byAdminWhen.description: The sentence on the status card of a closed request's page, shown in place of its progress, when an administrator closed it. {{when}} is how long ago or a date, for example "3h ago" or "Oct 5".

request.status.closed.byVote.text: This request was closed by vote.
request.status.closed.byVote.description: The sentence on the status card of a closed request's page, shown in place of its progress, when the group voted to close it.

request.status.closed.byVoteWhen.text: This request was closed by vote, {{when}}.
request.status.closed.byVoteWhen.description: The sentence on the status card of a closed request's page, shown in place of its progress, when the group voted to close it. {{when}} is how long ago or a date, for example "3h ago" or "Oct 5".

request.menu.startMore.description: Row in the ⋯ menu at the top of a request's page, for a person who already has an agent session on the request: starts another one.

request.menu.startMoreTitle.text: Start another agent session on this request
request.menu.startMoreTitle.description: Tooltip on the Start more work row in the ⋯ menu of a request's page. An agent session is a working conversation with an AI coding agent.

request.menu.releaseClaim.description: Row in the ⋯ menu at the top of a request's page, for an administrator: removes the mark that says {{username}} is working on the request, so somebody else can take it.

request.menu.releaseClaimUnnamed.description: Row in the ⋯ menu at the top of a request's page, for an administrator: removes another person's mark that says they are working on the request, when that person's name is not known.

request.menu.releaseClaimTitle.description: Tooltip on the row in the ⋯ menu of a request's page that removes {{username}}'s claim on the request. "(admin)" says only an administrator sees the row.

request.menu.releaseClaimTitleUnnamed.description: Tooltip on the row in the ⋯ menu of a request's page that removes another person's claim on the request, when that person's name is not known. "(admin)" says only an administrator sees the row.

request.menu.editTitle.description: Row in the ⋯ menu at the top of a request's page, for the person who filed it: lets them rewrite the request's title. "Edit" is a verb.

request.menu.editRequest.description: Row in the ⋯ menu at the top of a request's page, for the person who filed it: lets them rewrite the request's text. "Edit" is a verb; "request" is a noun.

page.thread.authorUnknown.description: Stands in for the author's name at the top of a change's page when the author is not known. Lower case, as a username would sit there.

page.thread.via.description: Small text after a middle dot beside the author's name at the top of a change's page, saying what the change was made with, so it starts in lower case. {{agent}} is the name of an AI coding product, Claude Code or Codex.

page.thread.viaExternal.description: Small text after a middle dot beside the author's name at the top of a change's page, saying what the change was made with, so it starts in lower case. The change was made with an AI coding agent that Homeroom does not know by name.

page.thread.viaGitHub.description: Small text after a middle dot beside the author's name at the top of a change's page, saying what the change was made with, so it starts in lower case. The change was brought in from a pull request on GitHub.

page.thread.onlyYou.text: Only you can see this change. Share it with the group to start a discussion.
page.thread.onlyYou.description: Shown where the replies would be on a person's own change that they have not shared with the project's members yet. "Change" is a noun; "Share" is a verb.

page.thread.shareToDiscuss.text: Share this change to start a discussion.
page.thread.shareToDiscuss.description: Notice in place of the message box at the bottom of a person's own change that is not shared with the project's members yet. "Share" is a verb; "change" is a noun.

page.thread.onlyYouLinked.text: Only you can see this change. Its conversation so far is on the request.
page.thread.onlyYouLinked.description: Shown where the replies would be on a person's own change that they have not shared with the project's members yet, when the change was built for a request: the request's page is where its conversation is. "Change" is a noun; "request" is a filed issue.

page.thread.shareToDiscussLinked.text: Share this change to discuss it here. Until then, reply on the request.
page.thread.shareToDiscussLinked.description: Notice in place of the message box at the bottom of a person's own change that is not shared with the project's members yet, when the change was built for a request: sharing opens the discussion here; until then people reply on the request. "Share" is a verb; "request" is a filed issue.

page.thread.replyPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the message box at the bottom of a change's page and of a request's page. A verb: write a reply.

page.votes.people.andLast.description: Builds a list of people's usernames that fills {{people}} in the lines of the Votes card on a change's page, for example "evan and maya" or "evan, maya and ash". {{names}} is every name but the last, already joined with commas, and {{last}} is the last name.

page.votes.name.description: Title of the card on a change's page that shows how the group's vote on the change stands. A plural noun.

page.votes.figure.notUp.text: Not up for a vote yet
page.votes.figure.notUp.description: The large figure on the Votes card of a change's page while the change is still being built and has not been put to the group.

page.votes.figure.closed.description: The large figure on the Votes card of a change's page when the change was closed without being approved. Describes the change: it is no longer open.

page.votes.figure.votedIn.description: The large figure on the Votes card of a change's page once the group approved the change.

page.votes.figure.contested.description: The large figure on the Votes card of a change's page when enough people voted No that the change no longer goes through on a timer.

page.votes.figure.needsYours.description: The large figure on the Votes card of a change's page when the change has enough Yes votes but still needs one from a member other than its author, and the viewer can give it. "Yes" is the vote.

page.votes.figure.needsAnother.description: The large figure on the Votes card of a change's page when the change has enough Yes votes but still needs one from a member other than its author. "Yes" is the vote.

page.votes.figure.reached.description: The large figure on the Votes card of a change's page once it has the Yes votes it needs. {{yes}} is how many Yes votes it has and {{needed}} how many it needs.

page.votes.figure.yourApproval.description: The large figure on the Votes card of a change's page when the viewer alone can approve the change.

page.votes.figure.needsMore_one.description: The large figure on the Votes card of a change's page while it is short of Yes votes. {{count}} is how many more Yes votes it needs.

page.votes.figure.needsMore_other.description: The large figure on the Votes card of a change's page while it is short of Yes votes. {{count}} is how many more Yes votes it needs.

page.votes.label.notUp.text: Votes: not up for a vote yet
page.votes.label.notUp.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Votes card of a change's page while the change is still being built.

page.votes.label.closed.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Votes card of a change's page when the change was closed without being approved.

page.votes.label.votedIn.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Votes card of a change's page once the group approved the change.

page.votes.label.tally.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Votes card of a change's page while the vote is open. {{yes}} is how many Yes votes it has and {{needed}} how many it needs.

page.votes.note.notAsked.text: Its author has not asked for approval yet.
page.votes.note.notAsked.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page, shown to people other than the author while the change is still being built.

page.votes.note.closed.text: This change was closed without going live.
page.votes.note.closed.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page when the change was closed. "Change" is a noun; "going live" means being applied to the running app.

page.votes.note.saidYes_one.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page: who voted Yes. {{people}} is one username or a list of them and {{count}} how many people that is.

page.votes.note.saidYes_other.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page: who voted Yes. {{people}} is one username or a list of them and {{count}} how many people that is.

page.votes.note.youSaidYes.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page, shown to the person reading it when they are the only one who voted Yes.

page.votes.note.youAndOthersSaidYes.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page, when the person reading it voted Yes along with others. {{people}} is a list of two or more people that starts with the word for "You" (the reader), for example "You and maya" or "You, maya and ash", so the verb is plural.

page.votes.people.you.description: The person reading, as the first name in a list of people who voted on a change, for example "You and maya said yes." Capitalized because it starts the sentence.

page.votes.note.yourEarlierYes.text: Your yes was on an earlier version.
page.votes.note.yourEarlierYes.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page: the reader's own Yes vote no longer counts because the change was updated after it.

page.votes.note.yourEarlierNo.text: Your no was on an earlier version.
page.votes.note.yourEarlierNo.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page: the reader's own No vote no longer counts because the change was updated after it.

page.votes.note.live.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page once the approved change is applied to the running app.

page.votes.note.updateComing.text: An update is coming: votes cast now are cleared when it lands.
page.votes.note.updateComing.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page when Homeroom bot or the change's author is changing it, or has a change queued: a Yes or No cast now is thrown away when the update lands, and everyone is asked again.

page.votes.note.goingLive.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page while the approved change is being applied to the running app.

page.votes.note.liveReload.text: It’s live. Reload to get it in this tab.
page.votes.note.liveReload.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page when the change is live in the app but the page open in this tab runs the version before it.

page.votes.note.stuck.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page when applying the approved change to the running app has stalled.

page.votes.note.failed.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page when applying the approved change to the running app failed.

page.votes.note.anyApprover_one.text: Any of the {{count}} approver can give it.
page.votes.note.anyApprover_one.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page while it is short of Yes votes, on a project where only invited approvers' votes count. "It" is the Yes vote the figure above asks for; {{count}} is how many approvers there are.

page.votes.note.anyApprover_other.text: Any of the {{count}} approvers can give it.
page.votes.note.anyApprover_other.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page while it is short of Yes votes, on a project where only invited approvers' votes count. "It" is the Yes vote the figure above asks for; {{count}} is how many approvers there are.

page.votes.note.anyMember_one.text: Any of the {{count}} members can give it.
page.votes.note.anyMember_one.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page while it is short of Yes votes. "It" is the Yes vote the figure above asks for; {{count}} is how many active members the project has (always more than one).

page.votes.note.anyMember_other.text: Any of the {{count}} members can give it.
page.votes.note.anyMember_other.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page while it is short of Yes votes. "It" is the Yes vote the figure above asks for; {{count}} is how many active members the project has (always more than one).

page.votes.facts.yes_one.description: Part of the tally line on the Votes card of a change's page: how many people voted Yes, for example "3 yes" in "3 yes · 1 no · 2 waiting". Only shown above zero.

page.votes.facts.yes_other.description: Part of the tally line on the Votes card of a change's page: how many people voted Yes, for example "3 yes" in "3 yes · 1 no · 2 waiting". Only shown above zero.

page.votes.facts.no_one.description: Part of the tally line on the Votes card of a change's page: how many people voted No, for example "1 no" in "3 yes · 1 no · 2 waiting". Only shown above zero.

page.votes.facts.no_other.description: Part of the tally line on the Votes card of a change's page: how many people voted No, for example "1 no" in "3 yes · 1 no · 2 waiting". Only shown above zero.

page.votes.facts.waiting_one.description: Part of the tally line on the Votes card of a change's page: how many people who can vote have not voted yet, for example "2 waiting" in "3 yes · 1 no · 2 waiting". Only shown above zero.

page.votes.facts.waiting_other.description: Part of the tally line on the Votes card of a change's page: how many people who can vote have not voted yet, for example "2 waiting" in "3 yes · 1 no · 2 waiting". Only shown above zero.

page.votes.facts.approval.description: Part of the tally line on the Votes card of a change's page, only on a project whose rule asks for a percentage of its people. {{share}} is the percentage of those people who have said yes and {{needed}} the percentage the rule asks for.

page.votes.facts.ends.description: Line on the Votes card of a change's page while a countdown runs after which the change goes live or is set aside. {{when}} is a date and time, for example "Sat 14 Nov, 10:30". Changes have no other deadline.

page.votes.facts.youSaidYes.description: Line on the Votes card of a change's page: the viewer's own current vote is Yes.

page.votes.facts.youSaidNo.description: Line on the Votes card of a change's page: the viewer's own current vote is No.

page.votes.facts.yourProposal.text: Proposing it counts as your yes.
page.votes.facts.yourProposal.description: Line on the Votes card of a change the viewer proposed, on a project whose rule counts proposing a change as a Yes from its author, who has not voted themselves.

page.votes.facts.notVoted.description: Line on the Votes card of a change's page: the viewer can vote on this change and has not.

page.votes.note.mergeCountdown.text: It goes live when the countdown ends, unless someone objects.
page.votes.note.mergeCountdown.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page while a timer is running after which the change is applied to the running app.

page.votes.note.rejectCountdown.text: It will be set aside when the countdown ends, unless someone speaks up.
page.votes.note.rejectCountdown.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page while a timer is running after which the change is turned down for lack of votes.

page.votes.note.contested.text: Enough people objected that it needs a straight majority of yes votes.
page.votes.note.contested.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page when No votes stopped the timer.

page.votes.note.earlierYes_one.text: {{people}}’s yes was on an earlier version.
page.votes.note.earlierYes_one.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page: a Yes vote that no longer counts because the change was updated after it. {{people}} is one username or a list of them and {{count}} how many people that is.

page.votes.note.earlierYes_other.text: {{people}}’s yes was on an earlier version.
page.votes.note.earlierYes_other.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page: Yes votes that no longer count because the change was updated after them. {{people}} is one username or a list of them and {{count}} how many people that is.

page.votes.note.earlierNo_one.text: {{people}}’s no was on an earlier version.
page.votes.note.earlierNo_one.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page: a No vote that no longer counts because the change was updated after it. {{people}} is one username or a list of them and {{count}} how many people that is.

page.votes.note.earlierNo_other.text: {{people}}’s no was on an earlier version.
page.votes.note.earlierNo_other.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page: No votes that no longer count because the change was updated after them. {{people}} is one username or a list of them and {{count}} how many people that is.

page.votes.note.needsOtherYes.text: Needs a Yes from another member before it can go live.
page.votes.note.needsOtherYes.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page: the change cannot be approved by its author alone and waits for a Yes vote from a different member of the project. "Go live" means the change is applied to the running app.

page.votes.note.advisory_one.text: {{count}} yes so far is from someone who isn’t an approver, so it doesn’t count.
page.votes.note.advisory_one.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page, on a project where only invited approvers' votes count: {{count}} Yes votes came from other people and do not count toward approval.

page.votes.note.advisory_other.text: {{count}} yeses so far are from people who aren’t approvers, so they don’t count.
page.votes.note.advisory_other.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page, on a project where only invited approvers' votes count: {{count}} Yes votes came from other people and do not count toward approval.

page.votes.note.thresholdWas.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page when the number of Yes votes needed has moved since voting began. {{now}} is how many are needed now and {{was}} how many were needed then.

page.votes.note.liveOnceFixed.text: It goes live once a fix passes testing.
page.votes.note.liveOnceFixed.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page when the change has the votes it needs but its automated checks are failing.

page.votes.note.liveOnceYouFixIn.text: It goes live once you fix it in {{agent}} and the fix passes testing.
page.votes.note.liveOnceYouFixIn.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page: the change has the votes it needs but its automated checks fail, and the viewer made it outside Homeroom in {{agent}}, such as "Claude Code".

page.votes.note.liveOnceYouFixThere.text: It goes live once you fix it where you made it and the fix passes testing.
page.votes.note.liveOnceYouFixThere.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page: the change has the votes it needs but its automated checks fail, and the viewer made it outside Homeroom in a tool the page cannot name.

page.votes.note.liveOnceYouFix.text: It goes live once you fix it and the fix passes testing.
page.votes.note.liveOnceYouFix.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page: the change has the votes it needs but its automated checks fail, and the viewer is the one who has to fix it.

page.votes.note.liveOnceAuthorFixes.text: It goes live once {{author}} fixes it and the fix passes testing.
page.votes.note.liveOnceAuthorFixes.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page: the change has the votes it needs but its automated checks fail, and someone else has to fix it. {{author}} is their username.

page.votes.note.liveOnceTested.text: It goes live once testing passes.
page.votes.note.liveOnceTested.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page when the change has the votes it needs and its automated checks have not passed yet.

page.votes.figure.noVote.description: The large figure on the Votes card of a change's page when the change is a project's first version, which goes live without a vote.

page.votes.label.noVote.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Votes card of a change's page when the change is a project's first version, which goes live without a vote.

page.votes.note.firstVersion.text: It’s the project’s first version, so it goes live without a vote.
page.votes.note.firstVersion.description: The line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page when the change is a project's first version and its automated checks have passed. "It" is the change.

page.votes.note.firstVersionOnceTested.text: It’s the project’s first version, so it goes live without a vote once testing passes.
page.votes.note.firstVersionOnceTested.description: The line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page when the change is a project's first version and its automated checks have not passed yet. "It" is the change.

page.votes.note.firstVersionOnceFixed.text: It’s the project’s first version, so it goes live without a vote once a fix passes testing.
page.votes.note.firstVersionOnceFixed.description: The line under the figure on the Votes card of a change's page when the change is a project's first version and its automated checks are failing. "It" is the change.

page.testing.name.testing.description: Title of the card on a change's page that shows the platform's automated testing of the change, while it is not finished or found a problem. A noun: the testing.

page.testing.name.tested.description: Title of the card on a change's page that shows the platform's automated testing of the change, once every check passed.

page.testing.figure.previewFailed.description: The large figure on the Testing card of a change's page when the preview (a running test copy of the app with the change) could not be started.

page.testing.figure.broken_one.description: The large figure on the Testing card of a change's page when the checks passed but the agent that takes the before and after screenshots found the app broken. {{count}} is how many of the declared changes broke. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

page.testing.figure.broken_other.description: The large figure on the Testing card of a change's page when the checks passed but the agent that takes the before and after screenshots found the app broken. {{count}} is how many of the declared changes broke.

page.testing.figure.passed.description: The large figure on the Testing card of a change's page once every automated check passed.

page.testing.figure.skipped.description: The large figure on the Testing card of a change's page when the change's automated checks were skipped.

page.testing.figure.failing.description: The large figure on the Testing card of a change's page when at least one automated check failed.

page.testing.figure.botFixing.description: The large figure on the Testing card of a change's page while Homeroom bot, the change's author, is fixing the automated checks that failed on it.

page.testing.figure.willRetry.description: The large figure on the Testing card of a change's page when the test run broke and the platform will start it again by itself.

page.testing.figure.broke.description: The large figure on the Testing card of a change's page when the test run itself broke and will not restart by itself.

page.testing.figure.notStarted.description: The large figure on the Testing card of a change's page before the preview is built and testing begins.

page.testing.figure.queued.description: The large figure on the Testing card of a change's page while the test run waits in line for a free place to run.

page.testing.figure.deferred.description: The large figure on the Testing card of a change's page while the test run is held back for the moment.

page.testing.figure.longer.description: The large figure on the Testing card of a change's page when the run has gone past its usual total time and is still going.

page.testing.figure.underMinuteLeft.description: The large figure on the Testing card of a change's page while testing runs and less than a minute is expected to remain. Lower case, as a measure.

page.testing.figure.minutesLeft.description: The large figure on the Testing card of a change's page while testing runs. {{minutes}} is the estimated number of minutes remaining; "min" is short for minutes. Lower case, as a measure.

page.testing.figure.building.description: The large figure on the Testing card of a change's page while the preview (a running test copy of the app with the change) is being built and no time estimate is known.

page.testing.figure.checking.description: The large figure on the Testing card of a change's page while the automated checks run and no time estimate is known. "It" is the change.

page.testing.label.previewFailed.text: Testing: the preview did not start
page.testing.label.previewFailed.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Testing card of a change's page when the preview could not be started.

page.testing.label.broken.text: Testing: the checks passed, but the screenshots found something broken
page.testing.label.broken.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Testing card of a change's page when the checks passed but the before and after screenshots ("screenshots") found the app broken.

page.testing.label.passed.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Testing card of a change's page once every automated check passed.

page.testing.label.skipped.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Testing card of a change's page when the checks were skipped.

page.testing.label.failing.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Testing card of a change's page when at least one automated check failed.

page.testing.label.botFixing.text: Homeroom bot is fixing what failed
page.testing.label.botFixing.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Testing card of a change's page while Homeroom bot, the change's author, is fixing the automated checks that failed on it.

page.testing.label.willRetry.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Testing card of a change's page when the test run broke and will restart by itself.

page.testing.label.broke.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Testing card of a change's page when the test run itself broke.

page.testing.label.notStarted.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Testing card of a change's page before testing begins.

page.testing.label.waiting.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Testing card of a change's page while the test run waits to start.

page.testing.label.whereLeft_one.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Testing card of a change's page while testing runs and a time estimate is known. {{where}} is a whole sentence saying where the run is, for example "Preview built, checks half done.", and {{count}} the estimated minutes remaining.

page.testing.label.whereLeft_other.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Testing card of a change's page while testing runs and a time estimate is known. {{where}} is a whole sentence saying where the run is, for example "Preview built, checks half done.", and {{count}} the estimated minutes remaining.

page.testing.label.where.description: Accessible description of the progress bar on the Testing card of a change's page while testing runs and no time estimate is known. {{where}} is a whole sentence saying where the run is, for example "Building the preview, step 2 of 5."

page.testing.note.broken.text: The checks passed, but the screenshot agent tried this change and the app broke.
page.testing.note.broken.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Testing card of a change's page. The screenshot agent is the automated agent that uses the app to take its before and after screenshots.

page.testing.note.olderMain.text: They passed on an older main.
page.testing.note.olderMain.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Testing card of a change's page, after how long the run took: the checks passed against an earlier state of "main", the project's current code, which has moved since. "main" is the name of the code branch and stays in English.

page.testing.note.skipped.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Testing card of a change's page when the change's automated checks did not run.

page.testing.lead.mainAll_one.text: Main is failing this test too, so it isn’t this change. Merges are paused until main’s fix lands, and this change’s checks run again by themselves then.
page.testing.lead.mainAll_one.description: First sentence on the Testing card of a change's page when the only test that failed also fails on main, the project's shared code, so the change is not at fault. "main" is the name of the code branch and stays in English. Followed by a link to the request that fixes main.

page.testing.lead.mainAll_other.text: Main is failing these tests too, so they aren’t this change. Merges are paused until main’s fix lands, and this change’s checks run again by themselves then.
page.testing.lead.mainAll_other.description: First sentence on the Testing card of a change's page when every test that failed also fails on main, the project's shared code, so the change is not at fault. "main" is the name of the code branch and stays in English. Followed by a link to the request that fixes main.

page.testing.lead.mainSome.text: These tests also fail on main, so they are not this change’s: {{main}}. These fail only in this change: {{own}}.
page.testing.lead.mainSome.description: First sentence on the Testing card of a change's page when some of the failing tests also fail on main, the project's shared code, and some fail only in this change. {{main}} and {{own}} each list test names, as the app's code wrote them, usually in English. "main" is the name of the code branch and stays in English.

page.testing.mainFix.link.text: See the request to fix main (#{{number}})
page.testing.mainFix.link.description: Link under the Testing card of a change's page, to the request the platform filed to fix main, the project's shared code. {{number}} is the request's number. "main" is the name of the code branch and stays in English.

page.testing.lead.tests_one.text: One of this change’s tests failed.
page.testing.lead.tests_one.description: First sentence on the Testing card of a change's page when the app's own automated tests found a problem with the change. It is followed by a sentence saying what went wrong. {{count}} is how many tests failed; English spells out the singular, and a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print {{count}}.

page.testing.lead.tests_other.description: First sentence on the Testing card of a change's page when the app's own automated tests found a problem with the change. It is followed by a sentence saying what went wrong. {{count}} is how many tests failed.

page.testing.lead.checks_one.text: One of this change’s checks failed on its preview.
page.testing.lead.checks_one.description: First sentence on the Testing card of a change's page when the change's automated checks found a problem on the change's own preview. It is followed by a sentence saying what went wrong. "Preview" is the copy of the app with this change in it, not the live app. {{count}} is how many checks failed; English spells out the singular, and a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print {{count}}.

page.testing.lead.checks_other.text: {{count}} of this change’s checks failed on its preview.
page.testing.lead.checks_other.description: First sentence on the Testing card of a change's page when the change's automated checks found a problem on the change's own preview. It is followed by a sentence saying what went wrong. "Preview" is the copy of the app with this change in it, not the live app. {{count}} is how many checks failed.

page.testing.why.testSaid.description: Second sentence on the Testing card of a change's page, saying what went wrong while a plain explanation is not available: the failing automated test and the message it failed with. {{test}} is the test's name and {{said}} its message, both as the app's code wrote them, usually in English.

page.testing.why.test.description: Second sentence on the Testing card of a change's page, saying what went wrong while a plain explanation is not available: the failing automated test, when it printed no message. {{test}} is the test's name as the app's code wrote it, usually in English.

page.testing.why.checkSaid.description: Second sentence on the Testing card of a change's page, saying what went wrong while a plain explanation is not available: the failing automated check and what it reported. {{check}} is the check's name and {{said}} its report, both as the app wrote them, usually in English.

page.testing.why.check.description: Second sentence on the Testing card of a change's page, saying what went wrong while a plain explanation is not available: the failing automated check, when it reported nothing more. {{check}} is the check's name as the app wrote it, usually in English.

page.testing.note.authorFixes.text: Its author needs to fix this before it can go live.
page.testing.note.authorFixes.description: Line under the Testing card of a change's page whose checks failed, shown only when the change has no author name to show instead: the author has to fix what failed before the change can be merged. "It" is the change.

page.testing.note.authorFixesNamed.text: {{name}} made this change and needs to fix this before it can go live.
page.testing.note.authorFixesNamed.description: Line under the Testing card of a change's page whose checks failed, shown to everybody but the change's author: the person named made the change and has to fix what failed before it can be merged. {{name}} is that person's username.

page.testing.note.botNotFixing.text: Homeroom bot built this change and isn’t fixing it. Any member of this project can take it from here.
page.testing.note.botNotFixing.description: Line under the Testing card of a change's page whose checks failed, when Homeroom bot built the change but nothing of its work on it is recorded: the bot is not fixing what failed, and any member of the project may take it over. "It" is the change.

page.testing.note.botPlatform.text: This looks like a problem with Homeroom’s preview, not with this change, so Homeroom bot is not changing it.
page.testing.note.botPlatform.description: Line under the Testing card of a change's page whose checks failed because Homeroom's preview of the app did not answer: the failure looks like the platform's and Homeroom bot is not changing the change for it. "It" is the change.

page.testing.note.botPlatformRerun.description: Sentence after the "This looks like a problem with Homeroom's preview" line on the Testing card of a change's page, shown to someone who can press Re-run checks. "Them" is the checks.

page.testing.note.botPlatformAsk.text: An admin can run its checks again.
page.testing.note.botPlatformAsk.description: Sentence after the "This looks like a problem with Homeroom's preview" line on the Testing card of a change's page, shown to someone who cannot press Re-run checks. "Its" is the change's.

page.testing.note.botFixing_one.text: Homeroom bot is fixing this, started {{count}} min ago.
page.testing.note.botFixing_one.description: Line under the Testing card of a change's page whose checks failed, while Homeroom bot (the change's author) is fixing what failed. {{count}} is how many minutes ago it started; "min" is short for minutes. "This" is what failed.

page.testing.note.botFixing_other.text: Homeroom bot is fixing this, started {{count}} min ago.
page.testing.note.botFixing_other.description: Line under the Testing card of a change's page whose checks failed, while Homeroom bot (the change's author) is fixing what failed. {{count}} is how many minutes ago it started; "min" is short for minutes. "This" is what failed.

page.testing.note.botFixingNow.text: Homeroom bot is fixing this, started just now.
page.testing.note.botFixingNow.description: Line under the Testing card of a change's page whose checks failed, while Homeroom bot (the change's author) is fixing what failed and started under a minute ago. "This" is what failed.

page.testing.note.botRetry.text: It is trying once more after running out of time.
page.testing.note.botRetry.description: Sentence after "Homeroom bot is fixing this, started N min ago." on the Testing card of a change's page, when the bot's first attempt to fix what failed ran out of time and this is its second. "It" is Homeroom bot.

page.testing.note.botQueued.text: Homeroom bot will start fixing this shortly.
page.testing.note.botQueued.description: Line under the Testing card of a change's page whose checks failed, while Homeroom bot's fix of what failed waits its turn in the bot's queue. "This" is what failed.

page.testing.note.botHandedOff.text: Homeroom bot couldn’t fix this on its own. The person who asked for it, or any member of this project, can take it from here.
page.testing.note.botHandedOff.description: Line under the Testing card of a change's page whose checks failed, after Homeroom bot (the change's author) gave up fixing what failed: who can take it over. "It" in the second sentence is the change.

page.testing.note.botStopped_one.text: Checks failing · Homeroom bot stopped after {{count}} try. You can let it try once more.
page.testing.note.botStopped_one.description: Line under the Testing card of a change's page whose checks failed, after Homeroom bot stopped at its own limit of fixes it may make by itself. Shown to the person who asked for it, or an admin, who may let it try again. {{count}} is the number of its tries.

page.testing.note.botStopped_other.text: Checks failing · Homeroom bot stopped after {{count}} tries. You can let it try once more.
page.testing.note.botStopped_other.description: Line under the Testing card of a change's page whose checks failed, after Homeroom bot stopped at its own limit of fixes it may make by itself. Shown to the person who asked for it, or an admin, who may let it try again. {{count}} is the number of its tries.

page.testing.note.botStoppedOthers_one.text: Checks failing · Homeroom bot stopped after {{count}} try. The person who asked for it or an admin can let it try again.
page.testing.note.botStoppedOthers_one.description: Line under the Testing card of a change's page whose checks failed, after Homeroom bot stopped at its own limit. Shown to someone who may not let it try again. {{count}} is the number of its tries.

page.testing.note.botStoppedOthers_other.text: Checks failing · Homeroom bot stopped after {{count}} tries. The person who asked for it or an admin can let it try again.
page.testing.note.botStoppedOthers_other.description: Line under the Testing card of a change's page whose checks failed, after Homeroom bot stopped at its own limit. Shown to someone who may not let it try again. {{count}} is the number of its tries.

tryAgain.label.description: Button on the Testing card of a change whose checks failed, after Homeroom bot stopped at its own limit: lets it make one more fix round.

tryAgain.asking.description: The Let it try again button while the request is in flight.

tryAgain.done.text: Homeroom bot will try once more.
tryAgain.done.description: Toast after someone lets Homeroom bot try once more at a change's failing checks.

tryAgain.failedHttp.text: Could not let it try again ({{status}}).
tryAgain.failedHttp.description: Toast when letting Homeroom bot try again failed with an HTTP status.

tryAgain.failedWith.text: Could not let it try again: {{error}}
tryAgain.failedWith.description: Toast when letting Homeroom bot try again failed for a reason the server gave.

page.testing.note.botRerun.text: Re-running the checks now would restart its fix.
page.testing.note.botRerun.description: Sentence after the "Homeroom bot is fixing this" line on the Testing card of a change's page, shown to a viewer who could press Re-run checks, which is disabled while the bot's fix runs. "Its" is Homeroom bot's.

page.testing.note.checkFailed.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Testing card of a change's page when the run failed and the number of failed checks is not known.

page.testing.note.willRetry.text: Testing will run again by itself.
page.testing.note.willRetry.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Testing card of a change's page when the test run broke and the platform restarts it.

page.testing.note.broke.text: The staging build or the test run itself broke.
page.testing.note.broke.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Testing card of a change's page when testing could not finish and the server gave no detail. The staging build is the building of the preview copy of the app.

page.testing.note.notStarted.text: Testing starts once its preview is built.
page.testing.note.notStarted.description: One sentence of the line under the figure on the Testing card of a change's page before testing begins. "Its" refers to the change; the preview is a running test copy of the app.

page.testing.note.whereUsual_one.description: The line under the figure on the Testing card of a change's page while testing runs and a time estimate is known. {{where}} is a whole sentence saying where the run is, for example "Preview built, checks half done."; what follows says how long a whole run usually takes on this project, and {{count}} is that number of minutes.

page.testing.note.whereUsual_other.description: The line under the figure on the Testing card of a change's page while testing runs and a time estimate is known. {{where}} is a whole sentence saying where the run is, for example "Preview built, checks half done."; what follows says how long a whole run usually takes on this project, and {{count}} is that number of minutes.

page.testing.note.whereUsualRough_one.text: {{where}} Usually about {{count}} minute on Homeroom, a rough estimate.
page.testing.note.whereUsualRough_one.description: The line under the figure on the Testing card of a change's page while testing runs, when the project has too few finished runs to know its own usual time. {{where}} is a whole sentence saying where the run is, and {{count}} is the usual number of minutes across Homeroom.

page.testing.note.whereUsualRough_other.text: {{where}} Usually about {{count}} minutes on Homeroom, a rough estimate.
page.testing.note.whereUsualRough_other.description: The line under the figure on the Testing card of a change's page while testing runs, when the project has too few finished runs to know its own usual time. {{where}} is a whole sentence saying where the run is, and {{count}} is the usual number of minutes across Homeroom.

page.testing.where.building.description: Sentence on the Testing card of a change's page saying where the test run is: the preview copy of the app is being built. {{step}} is the step it is on and {{steps}} how many steps there are.

page.testing.where.justStarted.description: Sentence on the Testing card of a change's page saying where the test run is: the preview copy of the app is built and the automated checks are just started.

page.testing.where.quarter.text: Preview built, checks a quarter done.
page.testing.where.quarter.description: Sentence on the Testing card of a change's page saying where the test run is: the preview copy of the app is built and the automated checks are a quarter done.

page.testing.where.third.text: Preview built, checks a third done.
page.testing.where.third.description: Sentence on the Testing card of a change's page saying where the test run is: the preview copy of the app is built and the automated checks are a third done.

page.testing.where.half.description: Sentence on the Testing card of a change's page saying where the test run is: the preview copy of the app is built and the automated checks are half done.

page.testing.where.twoThirds.text: Preview built, checks two thirds done.
page.testing.where.twoThirds.description: Sentence on the Testing card of a change's page saying where the test run is: the preview copy of the app is built and the automated checks are two thirds done.

page.testing.where.threeQuarters.text: Preview built, checks three quarters done.
page.testing.where.threeQuarters.description: Sentence on the Testing card of a change's page saying where the test run is: the preview copy of the app is built and the automated checks are three quarters done.

page.testing.where.almost.description: Sentence on the Testing card of a change's page saying where the test run is: the preview copy of the app is built and the automated checks are almost done.

page.testing.cost.both.text: Preview built in {{build}} min, checked in {{checks}}.
page.testing.cost.both.description: Sentence on the Testing card of a change's page, once every check passed, saying how long the run took. {{build}} is the minutes spent building the preview and {{checks}} the minutes spent on the checks; "min" is short for minutes and is said once for both numbers.

page.testing.cost.minutesMinutes.text: Preview built in {{build}} min, checked in {{checks}} min.
page.testing.cost.minutesMinutes.description: Sentence on the Testing card of a change's page, once every check passed, saying how long the run took. {{build}} is the minutes spent building the preview and {{checks}} the minutes spent on the checks; "min" is short for minutes.

page.testing.cost.minutesUnder.text: Preview built in {{build}} min, checked in under a minute.
page.testing.cost.minutesUnder.description: Sentence on the Testing card of a change's page, once every check passed, saying how long the run took. {{build}} is the minutes spent building the preview; "min" is short for minutes.

page.testing.cost.underMinutes.text: Preview built in under a minute, checked in {{checks}} min.
page.testing.cost.underMinutes.description: Sentence on the Testing card of a change's page, once every check passed, saying how long the run took. {{checks}} is the minutes spent on the checks; "min" is short for minutes.

page.testing.cost.underUnder.text: Preview built in under a minute, checked in under a minute.
page.testing.cost.underUnder.description: Sentence on the Testing card of a change's page, once every check passed, saying how long the run took, when both parts took less than a minute.

page.testing.cost.checked.description: Sentence on the Testing card of a change's page, once every check passed, saying how long the run took, when only the time of the checks is known. {{checks}} is that time in minutes; "min" is short for minutes.

page.testing.cost.checkedUnder.description: Sentence on the Testing card of a change's page, once every check passed, saying how long the run took, when only the time of the checks is known and it was less than a minute.

page.shots.taking.text: Taking the screenshots. They show up here when they are ready.
page.shots.taking.description: Line inside the Before and after card on a change's page while the before and after screenshots ("screenshots") are being taken.

shots.tiles.beforeNoRecording.description: Label over the small "before" picture of a change, in a gallery of before/after pictures, when there is a still image but no video recording of it. The words in the tags are a quieter note beside the label; keep the dot that separates them.

shots.tiles.afterNoRecording.description: Label over the small "after" picture of a change, in a gallery of before/after pictures, when there is a still image but no video recording of it. The words in the tags are a quieter note beside the label; keep the dot that separates them.

page.summary.missingPlan.text: No short summary has been added yet. The plan this change is built from is below.
page.summary.missingPlan.description: Shown in place of the summary on the page of a change that has no short summary yet and was built from a plan (the written description of the change); the plan's card is drawn below this line.

page.plan.untitled.description: Stands in for the title of the plan a change was built from, on the plan's card on the change's page and at the top of the reader it opens, when neither the change nor its session has a title. The plan is the written description of the change.

board.deploy.childLiveThroughPr.description: Status line at the top of the Workshop board's "Done" column when the newest merged change is running: everything up to and including this pull request is live. {{number}} is the pull request's number.

board.deploy.releaseTitle.text: Merged changes go live together, in the platform’s next release. Production is still running an earlier revision.
board.deploy.releaseTitle.description: Tooltip of the status line on the Workshop board's "Done" column of Homeroom's own project that says when the waiting merged changes go live in the platform's next release. A "revision" is one version of the code.

issue.action.answerBotQuestion.description: Main button on a request's card while Homeroom bot (the platform's builder bot, a name) waits for an answer to a question it asked on the request: opens the request's discussion with a reply to the bot ready.

issue.action.replyToBot.description: Main button on a request's card while Homeroom bot (the platform's builder bot, a name) waits for a reply to a note it left on the request: opens the request's discussion with a reply to the bot ready.

issue.bot.waiting.question.text: Homeroom bot asked a question here. Answer it, and it reads the request again.
issue.bot.waiting.question.description: Tooltip of the "Answer Homeroom bot's question" button on a request's card. "Homeroom bot" is the platform's builder bot, a name; "it" is the bot.

issue.bot.waiting.person.text: Homeroom bot said a person needs to decide this one. Reply to it once that is settled, and it reads the request again.
issue.bot.waiting.person.description: Tooltip of the "Reply to Homeroom bot" button on a request's card, when the bot said a person must make a decision before it builds the request. "Homeroom bot" is the platform's builder bot, a name; "it" is the bot.

issue.bot.waiting.empty.text: Homeroom bot found nothing to build here yet. Reply to it with more to go on, and it reads the request again.
issue.bot.waiting.empty.description: Tooltip of the "Reply to Homeroom bot" button on a request's card, when the bot found nothing it could build from the request as written. "Homeroom bot" is the platform's builder bot, a name; "it" is the bot.

workshop.row.byBot.description: Who made it, in the one line under a row's title in a project's Workshop lists and All items board, when the platform's builder bot made the item. "Homeroom bot" is the bot's name.

workshop.row.tag.takingShotsShort.description: The fewer words a row in a project's Workshop lists and All items board shows, beside a spinner, for the status tag "Taking before & after screenshots": screenshots of the change before and after are being taken. The full words are its tooltip and what a screen reader reads.

workshop.row.tag.previewReadyShort.description: The fewer words a row in a project's Workshop lists and All items board shows, beside an eye glyph, for the tag "Preview ready" on a change still being made: a preview build of it can be opened. The full words are its tooltip and what a screen reader reads.

workshop.row.tag.previewReadyVoteShort.description: The fewer words a row in a project's Workshop lists and All items board shows, beside an eye glyph, for the tag "Preview ready" on a change up for a vote: a preview build of it can be opened and tried before voting. The full words are its tooltip and what a screen reader reads.

workshop.row.tag.stateWho.description: Small status tag on a request's row in a project's Workshop lists and All items board: what is happening on it and who is doing it, for example "Picked up · zura". {{state}} is the state's own tag ("Picked up", "Being worked on", "Started", "Waiting for votes") and {{who}} a username.

workshop.row.tag.stateWhoMore_one.description: Small status tag on a request's row in a project's Workshop lists and All items board: what is happening on it, who is doing it, and how many other people are too, for example "Being worked on · zura +1". {{state}} is the state's own tag, {{who}} a username and {{count}} the number of other people.

workshop.row.tag.stateWhoMore_other.description: Small status tag on a request's row in a project's Workshop lists and All items board: what is happening on it, who is doing it, and how many other people are too, for example "Being worked on · zura +2". {{state}} is the state's own tag, {{who}} a username and {{count}} the number of other people.

workshop.row.tag.stateYou.description: Small status tag on a request's row in a project's Workshop lists and All items board: what is happening on it, done by the viewer, for example "Started · you". {{state}} is the state's own tag ("Picked up", "Being worked on", "Started", "Waiting for votes"). "you" is lower case in English because it follows the dot.

workshop.row.tag.stateYouMore_one.description: Small status tag on a request's row in a project's Workshop lists and All items board: what is happening on it, done by the viewer and other people, for example "Being worked on · you +1". {{state}} is the state's own tag and {{count}} the number of other people.

workshop.row.tag.stateYouMore_other.description: Small status tag on a request's row in a project's Workshop lists and All items board: what is happening on it, done by the viewer and other people, for example "Being worked on · you +2". {{state}} is the state's own tag and {{count}} the number of other people.

workshop.row.tag.onlyYou.description: Small status tag, beside a lock, on the row of the viewer's own change in a project's Workshop lists and All items board when nobody else can see it yet.

workshop.row.tag.specDraft.description: Small status tag, beside a lock, on a request's row in a project's Workshop lists and All items board when the viewer has a private draft change for it that nobody else can see yet. "Spec" is the written plan of the change.

badge.tag.checks.description: Status tag, beside a spinner and a progress bar, on a proposal's card and its row while its automated checks run; the bar shows how far they are.

chips.checks.label.description: Small status chip on a proposal's card, beside a spinner and a progress bar, while its automated checks run; the bar shows how far they are.

chips.checks.progress.of_one.description: How far a proposal's automated checks are: the accessible name of the progress bar inside its checks chip, and the start of the chip's tooltip. {{done}} is how many have finished and {{count}} how many there are in all. English reads the same for one and many.

chips.checks.progress.of_other.description: How far a proposal's automated checks are: the accessible name of the progress bar inside its checks chip, and the start of the chip's tooltip. {{done}} is how many have finished and {{count}} how many there are in all.

chips.checks.progress.soFar_one.description: How far a proposal's automated checks are while their total is not known yet: the accessible name of the pulsing progress bar inside its checks chip. {{count}} is how many have finished. English reads the same for one and many.

chips.checks.progress.soFar_other.description: How far a proposal's automated checks are while their total is not known yet: the accessible name of the pulsing progress bar inside its checks chip. {{count}} is how many have finished.

chips.checks.progress.starting.description: The accessible name of the pulsing progress bar inside a proposal's checks chip before any check has finished: the preview is being built and the checks are about to run.

chips.checks.progressTitle.of_one.text: {{done}} of {{count}} checks done. Automated tests are still running on the staging build. Merge is blocked until they pass.
chips.checks.progressTitle.of_one.description: Tooltip of a proposal's checks chip while its automated checks run. {{done}} is how many have finished and {{count}} how many there are in all. "Merge" is the noun: the proposal going live. English reads the same for one and many.

chips.checks.progressTitle.of_other.text: {{done}} of {{count}} checks done. Automated tests are still running on the staging build. Merge is blocked until they pass.
chips.checks.progressTitle.of_other.description: Tooltip of a proposal's checks chip while its automated checks run. {{done}} is how many have finished and {{count}} how many there are in all. "Merge" is the noun: the proposal going live.

chips.checks.progressTitle.soFar_one.text: {{count}} checks done so far. Automated tests are still running on the staging build. Merge is blocked until they pass.
chips.checks.progressTitle.soFar_one.description: Tooltip of a proposal's checks chip while its automated checks run and their total is not known yet. {{count}} is how many have finished. "Merge" is the noun: the proposal going live. English reads the same for one and many.

chips.checks.progressTitle.soFar_other.text: {{count}} checks done so far. Automated tests are still running on the staging build. Merge is blocked until they pass.
chips.checks.progressTitle.soFar_other.description: Tooltip of a proposal's checks chip while its automated checks run and their total is not known yet. {{count}} is how many have finished. "Merge" is the noun: the proposal going live.

chips.checks.progressTitle.starting.text: Checks starting. Automated tests are still running on the staging build. Merge is blocked until they pass.
chips.checks.progressTitle.starting.description: Tooltip of a proposal's checks chip before any of its automated checks has finished. "Merge" is the noun: the proposal going live.

shots.noticed.title.description: Small heading on a change's before & after screenshots, over problems the automated screenshot agent saw on the after build that are not part of the change; also that list's accessible name.

shots.noticed.change.description: Fact under a problem listed under "Also noticed" on a change's before & after screenshots: which of the change's declared changes it was seen while showing. {{number}} is that change's place in the list (1, 2, 3).

shots.noticed.alsoBefore.description: Fact under a problem listed under "Also noticed" on a change's before & after screenshots: the same problem shows on the version before the change, so the change did not cause it.

shots.noticed.notBefore.description: Fact under a problem listed under "Also noticed" on a change's before & after screenshots: the problem does not show on the version before the change.

page.steps.detail.release.description: Second line under "Going live" at the top of a merged change's page, for a change to Homeroom itself. {{release}} is a whole sentence saying when the next release carries it, for example "Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)". Only the closing punctuation is translated here.

workshop.row.tag.releaseTitle.description: Tooltip on a Workshop row's "Going live" tag, for a merged change to Homeroom itself. {{release}} is a whole sentence saying when the next release carries it. Only the closing punctuation is translated here.

badge.pill.releaseTitle.description: Tooltip on a change card's "Going live" pill, for a merged change to Homeroom itself. {{release}} is a whole sentence saying when the next release carries it. Only the closing punctuation is translated here.

vote.forceMerge.queued.text: Admin merge queued. It merges once main's checks of the last merge and any conflict with main are through.
vote.forceMerge.queued.description: Notice an administrator sees right after confirming Admin merge on a change: the merge is waiting its turn, not done yet. "main" is the repository's main branch.

vote.forceMerge.alreadyQueued.text: An admin merge is already queued for this change.
vote.forceMerge.alreadyQueued.description: Notice when an administrator picks Admin merge on a change that already has one waiting its turn. Nothing new is sent.

step.force.skipped.description: Line under a step of a change's merge checklist when an administrator's Admin merge skips that step, such as the vote or the checks.

step.force.headline.main.text: Merging… waiting for main's checks of the last merge
step.force.headline.main.description: Headline of a change's merge steps while an administrator's Admin merge waits for the repository's main branch to finish checking the last change merged into it.

step.force.headline.conflict.text: Merging… resolving a conflict with main
step.force.headline.conflict.description: Headline of a change's merge steps while an administrator's Admin merge waits for the platform to resolve a conflict between the change and the repository's main branch.

step.force.headline.merging.description: Headline of a change's merge steps while an administrator's Admin merge is being carried out.

step.force.headline.stopped.description: Headline of a change's merge steps when an administrator's Admin merge cannot go ahead; the step it stopped on says why.

page.votes.figure.adminMerge.description: The Votes card's figure on a change where an administrator used Admin merge: the vote is not being counted, so it is not asking anyone for a yes.

page.votes.note.adminMerge.text: {{by}} used Admin merge on {{head}}, so this change does not wait for votes.
page.votes.note.adminMerge.description: Note under the Votes card when an administrator's Admin merge is waiting. {{by}} is the administrator's username and {{head}} is the first seven characters of the commit identifier.

page.votes.note.adminMergeDropped.text: {{by}}'s admin merge was for an earlier commit ({{head}}). This version waits for its vote again.
page.votes.note.adminMergeDropped.description: Note under the Votes card after the author pushed new code, which ends an administrator's earlier Admin merge. {{by}} is the administrator's username and {{head}} is the first seven characters of the earlier commit's identifier.

page.votes.note.adminMergeNoHead.text: {{by}} used Admin merge, so this change does not wait for votes.
page.votes.note.adminMergeNoHead.description: Note under the Votes card when an administrator's Admin merge is waiting but the commit it applies to was not recorded. {{by}} is the administrator's username.

page.votes.note.adminMergeDroppedNoHead.text: {{by}}'s admin merge was for an earlier commit. This version waits for its vote again.
page.votes.note.adminMergeDroppedNoHead.description: Note under the Votes card after the author pushed new code, ending an administrator's earlier Admin merge whose commit was not recorded. {{by}} is the administrator's username.

page.votes.note.adminMergeNoName.description: Stands in for an administrator's username under the Votes card when it was not recorded.

governance.menu.copyLink.description: Row in the ⋯ menu on a governance vote's page: copies the address of the page to the clipboard.

governance.menu.copyLinkDone.description: Brief notice after pressing Copy link on a governance vote's page: the link is on the clipboard.

track.plan.description: One of the five stages of a change's progress line (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live), drawn under every request and change. Keep it to one short word.

track.build.description: One of the five stages of a change's progress line (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live), drawn under every request and change. Keep it to one short word.

track.checks.description: One of the five stages of a change's progress line (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live), drawn under every request and change. Keep it to one short word.

track.vote.description: One of the five stages of a change's progress line (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live), drawn under every request and change. Keep it to one short word.

track.live.description: One of the five stages of a change's progress line (Plan, Build, Checks, Vote, Live), drawn under every request and change. Keep it to one short word.
